author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Seven future outcomes, reproductive-neutrality prescriptions and three-generation framework

scenes.title: Waiting for the right time
scenes.viewerPurpose: Feel family plans receding as conditions change Connect daily arrangements with the next generation See housing careers and care inside private hopes
scenes.composition: Family plans move as housing and work conditions change
addOrChange: Replace motif with calendar, home search and care option, never demographic ranking.

cues.narration: You wait for the right time to have children, while the conditions keep moving away.
cues.visualAction: Move the hoped-for date while the person keeps seeking workable conditions.

cues.narration: Who Will Inherit the World asks how the lives we build shape the next generation.
cues.visualAction: Show the individual within the institutions surrounding that choice.

cues.narration: Housing, careers, care networks, and partner choices connect private hopes with the next generation.
cues.visualAction: Bring housing, work time and care into one practical view.

scenes.title: What institutions pass on
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice a community attracting people while frustrating their plans Keep passing on habits distinct from genetic claims Ask how new AI relationships could change those conditions
scenes.composition: A community supports careers while families need time and care
addOrChange: Add skill-sharing and a proposed AI tutor, separating cultural transmission from genes.

cues.narration: A community may attract thoughtful people while making their preferred family life difficult.
cues.visualAction: Show a welcoming workplace beside limited family support.

cues.narration: It looks at how habits and beliefs travel through families, while carefully separating those questions from genetics.
cues.visualAction: An adult teaches a practice while genetics remains a separate research question.

cues.narration: It also asks how AI companions, matching systems, and tutors might alter these relationships.
cues.visualAction: Introduce matching, companionship and tutoring as different unproven possibilities.

scenes.title: Which futures remain possible
scenes.viewerPurpose: Understand the focus is possible lives not ranking people Think about what would make wanted family life easier
scenes.composition: Different wanted lives remain equally dignified
addOrChange: Keep parenting and childless options at equal scale, with practical support instead of favored human types.

cues.narration: The question concerns the worlds we make possible, not a ranking of human worth.
cues.visualAction: Show several life plans without ranking them.

cues.narration: What would make it easier to build the family life people actually want?
cues.visualAction: End with time, housing and care beside the person’s own choice.
